name: fancy-button
title: Fancy Button
description: A compound button component with gradient overlay effects, multiple variants, and sizes. Uses namespace exports: FancyButton.Root, FancyButton.Icon.

docs.lead: A compound button component with gradient overlay effects, multiple variants, and sizes.
docs.usage:
import * as FancyButton from "@/components/ui/fancy-button"

<FancyButton.Root variant="neutral">
  <FancyButton.Icon as={ArrowIcon} />
  Button
</FancyButton.Root>

examples.title: Variants
examples.description: All four visual variants: neutral (dark + gradient), primary (brand color), error (destructive), and basic (white + stroke).

examples.title: With Icon
examples.description: Use FancyButton.Icon with the `as` prop for polymorphic icon rendering.

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Fancy buttons come in medium (default), small, and xsmall sizes.

examples.title: Disabled
examples.description: Disabled state removes gradient overlays and applies muted styling across all variants.

examples.title: As Child
examples.description: Use the asChild prop with Radix Slot to render as a different element, such as a link.

api.name: FancyButton.Root
api.description: The main fancy button component with gradient overlay effects.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Renders as child element using Radix Slot

props.name: static
props.description: Turns off the scale-on-press feedback, for places where the motion would distract.

api.name: FancyButton.Icon
api.description: Polymorphic icon container that receives variant and size from FancyButton.Root.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component to render as
